metadata.name: sql_example
metadata.description: Get additional information about courses available at Stackademy.

prompt.systemRole: You are a helpful sales agent for Stackademy. You can provide information about courses available at Stackademy.

sqlData.sqlQuery: SELECT c.course_code, c.course_name, c.description, c.cost, prerequisite.course_code AS prerequisite_course_code, prerequisite.course_name AS prerequisite_course_name FROM courses c LEFT JOIN courses prerequisite ON c.prerequisite_id = prerequisite.course_id WHERE ((c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', {description}, '%')) OR ({description} IS NULL)) AND (c.cost <= {max_cost} OR {max_cost} IS NULL) ORDER BY c.prerequisite_id;

parameters.name: max_cost
parameters.description: the maximum cost that a student is willing to pay for a course.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: areas of specialization for courses in the catalogue.
